key_points: Costco Q4 2026 earnings beat expectations but comparable sales growth slowed
Membership revenue growth declined for a third straight quarter, prompting a price target cut from Sanford C. Bernstein
Expansion plan of $7.5 bn signals long‑term growth but adds near‑term execution risk
One‑time $184 m tariff refund boosted net income, limiting the earnings quality
Overall mix of earnings beat and weakening core metrics creates modest downside pressure in the near term
